_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: DELTA of exactly 80.00 and it is the FILER'S ARITHMETIC, not a missing or duplicated row. The 21 itemized rows sum to 12,880.00; the schedule's own printed 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS' box says $12,800 and the cover says $12,800. The row count was gated independently against the page's physical row bands (21 written bands, bands 6-26) and the whole Amount column was re-read at 700 dpi as a single strip. The one cell that could absorb the difference is line 2 (Hank Louis, 2,580.-): read at 1400 dpi it is a clear 8 with a pinched waist, plainly distinct from the round zeros this writer makes elsewhere in the same column (1,000 / 1500 / 3000), so it is transcribed as written rather than bent to 2,500 to force closure. Both figures are named here and reconciles=False; nothing is repaired.

expenditures.detail: exact - 7 rows sum to 15,043.79 = the page's own 'TOTAL EXPENSES' box AND the cover. Cover balance -2,243.79 = 12,800 - 15,043.79 is the filer's own arithmetic off his own stated contribution figure and is untouched.

_meta_itemized.page_gates: The 2026 sheet prints its section total INSIDE the grid as a labelled last row. p2 ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT ends in 'TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS  $12,800' (handwritten, escalated to 1200 dpi and unambiguous) and the cover states 12,800 - but the 21 itemized rows sum to 12,880, so this side does NOT gate and is published with both figures named. p3 ITEMIZED EXPENSE REPORT ends in 'TOTAL EXPENSES  $15,043.79' and the 7 rows reproduce it TO THE CENT (244.49 + 400 + 2800 + 10000 + 705 + 799.30 + 95 = 15,043.79), matching the cover - which is the control showing the read method closes when the filer's arithmetic does. No specimen rows exist on the 2026 form.

_meta_itemized.notes: THE 2026 SUMMIT SHEET IS NOT WHAT THE BRIEF ANTICIPATED, and this is precedent for the rest of the 2026 residue: its columns are DATE | NAME OF CONTRIBUTOR | ADDRESS | AMOUNT - there is NO Zip Code column, and the ADDRESS column on this filing holds ONLY CITY AND STATE ('Park City, UT', 'Salt Lake City, UT', 'Fresno, CA', 'Beaver Creek, CO'), no street lines at all. So donor_city/donor_state are READ FROM THE PAGE here and are NOT blank - the brief's instruction that 2024/2026 filings carry blank city/state does not hold for this form as this filer completed it. Nothing on either schedule page is blacked out or whited out: the file name's '_Redacted' suffix comes from the county's redaction pass elsewhere in the document, and the only struck text on the ledger is the FILER'S OWN correction on line 10 (see that row's note). THE DATE COLUMN IS ENTIRELY EMPTY on both schedules - the filer completed name, address and amount and never dated a single transaction - so every row carries a blank date with needs_review=1. That is a property of the document, not a transcription gap, and no date is ever inferred from the report period. Handwriting is a clean blue ballpoint and the scan is good; the six escalations were the Louis amount (1400 dpi), the TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS box (1200 dpi), both amount-column strips and both name/address strips at 700 and 500 dpi to gate the row count. GEOMETRY is MEASURED on both pages and crop-verified (p2 band 6 reproduces 'Bill Murcko / Macinac, MI / 1,000.-' and band 26 'Cherie Beck / Park City, UT / 1000'; p3 band 5 reproduces 'Callidum Mktg / Signs-Mailers / 244.49' and band 11 'Campaign Verify / Voter Lists / 95.00'). On p2 rowbands detects no vertical rules, so the stored boxes use the module's default full-width span; on p3 they are bounded by the page's own detected column rules.
